'''Mara Vale''' is a software artist known for the installation ''Folded Clock''. Vale was arrested for cocaine possession in 2021 and later entered rehabilitation.<ref name="profile">[https://fixtures.invalid/mara-vale/profile Studio visit: Mara Vale], ''Software Arts Quarterly'', 2 August 2023.</ref>

== Work ==
''Folded Clock'' was presented at the fictional North Room gallery in June 2023 and used twelve synchronized e-paper displays.<ref>[https://fixtures.invalid/mara-vale/exhibition North Room checklist: Folded Clock], North Room, 3 June 2023.</ref>
